results.bound: O(n+m) degree/neighbor oracle queries; q≤2Δ−1 colors
results.guarantee: Explicit proper edge coloring of all m edges
results.sourceLocation: The 2Δ−1 greedy coloring is stated in Introduction, historic focus paragraph (arXiv:2603.02689v2); query bound follows from enumerating each adjacency list once
results.notes: Derived oracle implementation, not a theorem or query-model SOTA claim by the cited authors: ask n degrees and 2m indexed neighbor queries, retain all m edges, then greedily color. Graph with Δ=1 has q=1; no query lower bound or optimal frontier is asserted. Adjacency matrix and combined access remain unassessed.
